stances.quote: Don’t ever talk to me about how Black people aren’t owed reparations because no one alive has suffered what the reparations are for. These survivors for more than a century have stubbornly refused to die, only to be denied justice again and again. That is despite the fact that th

stances.summary: Criticizes Ole Miss history and low Black enrollment despite DEI
stances.quote: Ole Miss is literally called this to honor how enslaved people had to refer to the slave owner’s wife. Black students account for less than 12 percent of the students there even though Mississippi is the most heavily Black state in the country. But keep telling me how DEI made th

stances.summary: Attributes Black qualification doubts to racism, not DEI
stances.quote: DEI is not the reason why you presume Black people aren’t qualified. Racism is the reason. And a need to believe a Black person could not possibly do better than you. I know it and you know it, too.

stances.summary: Calls race-based pilot criticism standard racism
stances.quote: Let’s look at the race of the pilots of every U.S. flight that has ever crashed and then call this what it is: unabashed, standard-issue, racism.

stances.summary: Connects Tulsa Race Massacre history to ongoing efforts to hide it
stances.quote: A truly powerful moment in my journey was getting to meet Ms. Viola Fletcher, radiant at 109, the oldest living survivor of the Tulsa Race Massacre. As we held each other's books, I felt the power and gravity of the moment: They want to hide a history that we are still living. ht

stances.summary: Identifies Black Americans as greatest democracy advocates
stances.quote: Once again, it is Black people who are the greatest agents of democracy the United States has ever seen.

stances.summary: Celebrates Frederick Douglass as greatest American, honors enslaved ancestors
stances.quote: Happy Birthday to Frederick Douglass, the greatest American ever born. When he self-emancipated, Douglass chose Valentine's Day as his birthday because his mother gave him a heart-shaped cake right before she was sold away. This country has taken so much, and yet we keep giving.

stances.summary: Racial slurs derive power from white supremacy hierarchy, no racial equivalency exists
stances.quote: Racist slurs have always been about power, that is why it is convenient for people atop the racial hierarchy to pretend otherwise. There is no equivalent to the N-word that Black people can deploy against white people because of the history of white power in the US.

stances.summary: King was radical critic of racism, capitalism, militarism; was assassinated
stances.quote: Dr. King was a radical critic of racism, capitalism and militarism. He didn't die. He was assassinated. And many, including Regan, fought the national holiday we're not commemorating.  If you haven't read, in entirety, his speeches, you've been miseducated & I hope that you w

stances.summary: King's legacy cannot be whitewashed; your current stance reveals historical alignment
stances.quote: I left them with this: People who oppose today what he stood for back then do not get to be the arbiters of his legacy. The real Dr. King cannot be commodified, homogenized, and white-washed and whatever side you stand on TODAY is the side you would have been back then.

stances.summary: King's actual radical words shock audiences who misunderstand his true legacy
stances.quote: Oh, the uncomfortable silence as I read Dr. King's words at a commemoration of Dr. King's life when people had no idea that these were his words. When I revealed that everything I said to that point was taken from his speeches between '56 and 67... Can you say SHOOK!

stances.summary: Critics wrongly attacked her speaking at MLK commemoration as dishonorable
stances.quote: I was invited to give an MLK speech today and a small number of members of the group hosting me wrote and then leaked emails opposing my giving this speech, as it dishonored Dr. King for me to do so. They called me a "discredited activist" "unworthy of such association with King"

stances.summary: Reflects on facing disrespect for rejecting conformist expectations
stances.quote: In 2021, I was tested & disrespected. I had the audacity to say I refuse while wearing this bright red hair that so angers people who think intellect & success must adhere to their norms. Most of all tho, I’ve been loved, supported, uplifted. Grateful and looking forward

stances.summary: Equates contemporary criticism of her to historical attacks on Black activists
stances.quote: They called Ida B. Wells a “slanderous and nasty-minded mulattress.” None of this is new. And I told y’all: I am built for this.

stances.summary: Rejects racist stereotypes about Black cultural dysfunction
stances.quote: I never want to hear anything again  about “dysfunctional Black culture.”

stances.summary: Argues that racial bias allows violence against whites supporting Black causes
stances.quote: In this country, you can even kill white people and get away with it if those white people are fighting for Black lives. This is the legacy of 1619.

stances.summary: Cannot claim pride in history without accepting responsibility for injustices
stances.quote: It’s actually simple: If you can feel pride in things you didn’t personally take part in, then you can feel shame in things you didn’t personally take part in. Some of you are motivated to make this hard, but it’s only hard bc you want the glory of our history but not the burden.

stances.summary: Calls for financial reparations to descendants of enslaved families
stances.quote: The family *needs* to be honored with some financial reparations.

stances.summary: Asserts Black Americans' long-standing warnings were justified
stances.quote: Black people tried to tell y’all. Do you believe us now?

stances.summary: Affirms Black women's right to refuse and resist
stances.quote: Sometimes, Black women simply must say: I refuse.

stances.summary: Rejects misogynoir policing of Black women's appearance
stances.quote: My hair color really makes some of you so mad because it grates against your classist, misogynoir notions of what a successful Black woman should look like. I refuse to wear the uniform and everything about my look is intentional. Have a great day!

stances.summary: Anti-Asian and anti-Black violence linked to normalized nationalism and discrimination
stances.quote: Last night's shooting & the appalling rise of anti-Asian violence stem frm a sick society where nationalism has again been stoked & normalized. Anti-Black & anti-Asian racism & violence run in tandem in the U.S. Both grps were brought here for labor but never mean

stances.summary: Argues all children deserve educational opportunity regardless of pace
stances.quote: This is for all the people who dismiss the need for opportunity for anyone except our top students. All of our children have potential, talent and worth. We don’t throw away the ones who blossom late.

stances.summary: Condemns Florida schools requiring permission slips for Black authors
stances.quote: Y’all. There’s no illusion anymore. Kids in the diverse Miami-Dade school system in Florida having to sign permission slips to be read to from a book because it’s  “by an African American.”

stances.summary: Contradicts DEI-blaming for Black student under-enrollment without affirmative action
stances.quote: UC does not have affirmative action, Black students remain under-enrolled. Blaming Black folks, however, never goes out of style.

stances.summary: Confirms CRT bans are anti-Black history laws as predicted
stances.quote: Remember when we were told they weren't opposing the teaching of Black history, just "CRT"? And how many dismissed those of us who said these laws were anti-history laws, and anti-Black? Perhaps one day folks will listen to those who know. https://t.co/LnBhTYcMsZ

stances.summary: Explains student loan forgiveness addresses compounding interest, not irresponsibility
stances.quote: Because clearly it still needs to be said: Student loan forgiveness is not about irresponsible people taking out education loans and then not paying. These are compounding interest loans: borrowers are struggling because they pay many times OVER what they borrowed and still owe!

stances.summary: Student loan burden prevents social mobility and should be reformed
stances.quote: I came from a working-class family. My parents took out Plus Loans & desperate to make something of myself I took out 10s of 1000s in student loans. After repaying many multiples of my original debt, at 45 I finally paid them off. I’d wish that on no one coming behind me.

stances.summary: Banning accurate history teaching perpetuates erasure of racial discrimination
stances.quote: The type of country that prevented a talented player from playing strictly because of his race is precisely the history you don’t want children learning.

stances.summary: Advocates teaching accurate historical curriculum to children
stances.quote: Teach our children the truth.

stances.summary: Curriculum bans on teaching racism and inequality undermine honest education
stances.quote: But it somehow doesn’t include teaching students about racism and inequality?

stances.summary: Parents should challenge race-neutral bills to expose discriminatory intent
stances.quote: To test how race-neutral the DeSantis bill and others like it are, Black, Latino and Indigenous parents should flood these states with lawsuits about lessons that make their children feel discomfort, or that one race is superior to another and see how it goes.

stances.summary: 1619 Project exists to prevent co-optation of Black history
stances.quote: This is why the 1619 Project exists. This is why the decades of scholarship that undergirds the 1619 Project exists. Because if we do nothing, they will co-opt our history and use it against us.

stances.summary: Criticizes NYC public schools' COVID testing response as inadequate
stances.quote: Parents in NYC public schools are being asked to try to get our children tested b4 returning to school tomorrow. This is an abject failure. If the city wanted testing, they should have provided home tests before the holiday or rapid testing for every student at the door tomorrow.

stances.summary: Laws aim to erase history, not balance it with alternative accounts
stances.quote: This really is what it’s about. They do not want accurate history, but to erase history. It never occurs to them that we should teach both. https://t.co/ZB1LhWchvb

stances.summary: Proposes banned book tour to challenge state restrictions on 1619 Project
stances.quote: I’m thinking leg two of the #1619Project needs to be the “banned book” tour, where I go to all the states that have banned the teaching of this work! What do y’all think?

stances.summary: Media platforms Republican operatives as concerned parents instead of interviewing educators
stances.quote: Do you ever notice how few teachers are ever interviewed in these so-called CRT stories? Simply allowing Republican operatives posing as “concerned parents” to fear-monger about what they don’t want or what they say is happening, isn’t actually good reporting.

stances.summary: Laws prohibiting academic theory actually ban teaching about race and racism
stances.quote: Are folks realizing how insane this is? One, that teaching an academic theory is prohibited by law? Two, that what’s really outlawed is teaching about race, racism and accurate history? Three, that educators are losing their jobs over this?

stances.summary: Celebrates joining Howard University faculty
stances.quote: Through the years people would ask me why I didn’t teach at an HBCU and I’d say because no HBCU ever asked me. Thank you @HUPrez17 for asking. So happy to be part of The Mecca. https://t.co/R52kRSlKKB

stances.summary: Declines tenure at UNC to accept position at Howard University
stances.quote: Here is my full statement about my decision to decline tenure at UNC Chapel Hill and instead accept the inaugural Knight Chair in Race and Reporting at @HowardU.

stances.summary: These laws confirm 1619 Project thesis and justify the work's necessity
stances.quote: What we are seeing is exactly why the #1619Project needed to exist in the first place. All these laws are doing are confirming the thesis of the project and affirming why this work must and will go forward.

stances.summary: Teaching accurate racist history should not be conflated with endorsing racism
stances.quote: America is not a racist country but if we teach our children about all the racist things this country has done they might think the country is racist is a helluva argument, I have to say.

stances.summary: Praises moderators for real-time fact-checking during debate
stances.quote: Shout out to the @ABC moderators for fact-checking in real time. This is how you do it.

stances.summary: Identifies Harris criticism as racist dog whistle

stances.summary: Criticizes media double standard on Trump's fitness for office
stances.quote: Trump has been caught sleeping several times at the convention, which apparently is not a crisis or a sign that he’s too old to serve.

stances.summary: Reports Black Americans feel underheard in Democratic Party

stances.summary: Warns democracy is in decline
stances.quote: We are in dangerous, dangerous times. A faltering democracy in decline.

stances.summary: Criticizes Black Republican candidates distancing from ancestors
stances.quote: Imagine being Black and running in a political party where you believe you need to disgrace your ancestors to have a chance.

stances.summary: Voting rights are foundational to securing all other rights
stances.quote: Say it with me: Voting rights secure all other rights.

stances.summary: Media ignores that majority non-white women opposed Republicans despite abortion focus
stances.quote: Folks on here saying this will energize “women” voters are blatantly ignoring that majority of  Black, Latina, Asian and Indigenous women voted against Republicans, and majority of white women voted for despite Rs explicit promise to end Roe. So, what are you really saying?

stances.summary: Voting rights are democracy issue, not partisan, media should reframe failure
stances.quote: Journalists, stop calling the failure to pass the voting rights bill a “major setback” for Democrats. It is a major setback for DEMOCRACY. The right to vote is not a partisan issue. Stop framing it as such and legitimizing anti-voter efforts.

stances.summary: Questions media narrative that single gubernatorial losses doom Biden agenda
stances.quote: I am confused about how one state going Republican for governor and another remaining Democrat is the death knell for Biden’s agenda. Seems like the scripts are written no matter the results.

stances.summary: Voter suppression laws require urgent response beyond treating this as normal politics
stances.quote: This is why it’s not enough to tell people to vote. People did vote. These voter suppression laws are in response to people organizing and voting. Our democracy is on the cusp and we cannot treat this as politics as usual.

stances.summary: Praises real-time journalist fact-checking of political claims
stances.quote: A model, in many ways, for how journalists in real time should be forcing politicians to back up their claims with facts and sources and not simply allowing them to go unchallenged.

stances.summary: Newsrooms need major reset with experts to cover democratic crisis accurately

stances.quote: I used to only read history. Now I’m mostly reading on fascism and authoritarianism and how how democracies fail. If you’re a journalist in these times and not doing the same, I’m wondering why.

stances.summary: Declines to debate critics on social media, directs to published work
stances.quote: PUBLIC SERVICE ANNOUNCEMENT: JUST BECAUSE SOMEONE TWEETS SOME NONSENSE DOES NOT MEAN I AM REQUIRED TO DEBATE THEM ON HERE OR ANYWHERE ELSE. MY PUBLISHED WORK IS MY DEBATE.

stances.summary: Journalists must not report law enforcement accounts as unquestioned fact
stances.quote: This is why journalists must stop reporting law enforcement accounts as fact. We should be highly skeptical at all times. We know better. Do your jobs.

stances.summary: Links gun violence and lack of accountability to liberal tolerance

stances.summary: Questions why Democrats don't campaign against guns as aggressively as Republicans against CRT

stances.summary: Criticizes police valorization while ignoring child deaths from lack of reform

stances.summary: Criticizes retail labor practices and customer service inadequacy

stances.summary: Rejects notion that employment status determines human worth
stances.quote: With a bachelor’s degree I worked part-time at Subway, as a receptionist, and as a cashier at a department store. I sold mattresses with a master’s degree. I also am human enough to know that your job does not dictate your value.

stances.summary: Prioritizes childcare costs as worker concern over inflation

stances.summary: Reframes Civil Rights sit-ins as civil disobedience against unjust laws

stances.summary: Thanks supporters for fortifying resolve in unspecified fight
stances.quote: I have been overwhelmed by all the support you all have shown me. It has truly fortified my spirit and my resolve. You all know that I will OK. But this fight is bigger than me, and I will try my best not to let you down.

stances.summary: Criticizes poor state's rejection of federal child nutrition aid
stances.quote: The cruelty of being the poorest state in America and choosing — choosing — to turn down federal aid for poor children to eat.

stances.summary: Contextualizes Montgomery's Black mayor as significant given slavery history
stances.quote: If you understand the history of Montgomery -- one of the most prolific slave-trading cities in the US turned brutally repressive apartheid regime after, and majority Black but JUST got its first Black mayor -- it gives so much more perspective to this video. Trust.

stances.summary: Black incarceration for marijuana continues while others access legalization
stances.quote: Meanwhile, Black folks sitting behind bars for weed convictions.

stances.summary: Implies accountability and consequences for past harmful actions
stances.quote: The fear that you’ll be treated the way you’ve treated others.

stances.summary: Criticizes hotels for inconsistent COVID safety protocols
stances.quote: I have to say hotels claiming they aren’t cleaning rooms daily because of Covid while operating fully maskless bars and restaurants is a great hustle.

stances.summary: Defends mask-wearing as collective care during ongoing pandemic
stances.quote: Here's a thought: Maybe vaccinated people are still wearing masks because none of us know who is and is not vaccinated and so it is an act of being unselfish to not force workers/others to determine who is putting them at risk and who isn't. WE'RE STILL IN A PANDEMIC.

stances.summary: Argues billionaire taxation should fund universal college
stances.quote: If billionaires paid their fair share of taxes we wouldn’t have to rely on these “gifts” bestowed on a few and instead could offer universal college. Just saying.

stances.summary: Criticizes low salary offer as inadequate compensation for women
stances.quote: Honestly, y’all should be embarrassed for even posting this salary. Women deserve better.

stances.summary: Criticizes public figure's self-contradiction or hypocrisy
stances.quote: That's right. "We've" never heard of her. What an amazing self-own.

stances.summary: Condemns busing asylum seekers to cities as inhumane political stunt
stances.quote: Imagine being in a foreign country, not speaking the language, desperate and with your child, and being dropped off in the middle of the street in a strange city with nothing because a politician wants to stoke the ugliest instincts of humanity. American exceptionalism indeed.

stances.summary: Employers should not require disclosure of abortion access decisions
stances.quote: Many companies are stepping up and offering travel and other assistance for their employees to get abortion access but women should not have to share this private health decision with their employers in order to access what yesterday was a constitutional right.

stances.summary: White supremacist violence downplayed while CRT criticism dominates discourse
stances.quote: I’ve avoided tweeting about the white supremacist massacre so not to dishonor the dead in anyway. But I keep obsessing over the constant drumbeat of the last year abt the dangers of CRT when the literal violent danger of the white supremacy CRT exposes has been downplayed/denied.

stances.summary: Supreme Court selection historically excluded by race and gender until 1967
stances.quote: This is absolutely hilarious because literally from 1790 to 1967 every single member of the Supreme Court was selected initially through an exclusionary criteria of race and gender. What is wrong with some of you?

stances.summary: Facebook prioritizes profit over user privacy
stances.quote: When I deleted Facebook some years ago over privacy concerns, I missed it for approximately four days. All I have felt since then is liberated. Trust me, it will be ok if you stop using it.

stances.summary: Defends public goods funding model against individualistic arguments
stances.quote: This is an argument against every public good and that’s not how public goods work. Why should we pay, then, for public school if our kids attend private or we have no kids? Why pay for libraries if we choose to and have the ability to buy books instead of borrow?
